related_questions.question: What should I do if I tested positive for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: If your COVID-19 test is positive Monitor your symptoms. If you have any emergency warning signs, seek emergency care immediately. Seek health care right away for treatment if you have risk factors for severe illness. Treatment may be an option to make your symptoms less severe and shorten the time you are sick.

related_questions.question: How long should you isolate if you are positive for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: If you did not have symptoms but have tested positive, stay at home for 5 days from the day you first tested positive. Avoid meeting people at very high risk for 10 days from the day you first tested positive.
related_questions.title: If you have COVID-19 - HSE.ie

related_questions.question: When to return to work after COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: Generally, after testing positive for COVID-19, individuals should isolate for at least 5 days, regardless of vaccination status, and can return to work or school after 5 days if symptoms are improving and there's been at least 24 hours without a fever, according to Yale New Haven Health. It's crucial to continue wearing a mask around others until day 11 and avoid close contact with those who are at high risk of severe illness.

list.title: Isolation:
list.snippet: Begin isolating immediately upon testing positive or experiencing symptoms.

list.title: Return to Work/School:
list.snippet: You can leave isolation after 5 days if your symptoms are improving and you have been fever-free for at least 24 hours without the use of fever-reducing medication.

list.title: Masking:
list.snippet: Continue to wear a mask around others until at least day 11 to minimize the risk of transmission.

list.title: Close Contact:
list.snippet: Continue to avoid close contact with those who are more vulnerable to severe COVID-19 until at least day 11.

list.title: Testing:
list.snippet: If you are exposed to COVID-19, get tested even if you don't have symptoms and wear a mask.

list.title: Seek Guidance:
list.snippet: Consult your workplace or school policies for specific recommendations.
